verdict.rationale: cubic connects to third-party coding agents rather than hosting partner-built agent apps. Its official MCP server lets an external coding agent read review findings, request reviews and triage issues. The CLI produces fix prompts for your coding agent, and local reviews can use an existing ChatGPT or Claude Code subscription. Its 'custom agents' are first-party review rules, not partner apps. Missing for 10: a partner or third-party agent app marketplace or catalog, a documented framework for plugging partner-built agents into cubic workflows, and independent corroboration of third-party agent integrations.
